notes.title: Patchnotes 1.29 : The french gender update
notes.notes:
This update mostly contains fixes in the french texts where the player was misgendered.
Also, you can now leave the University with mouse controls!

notes.title: The Spoiler Update
notes.notes:
You finished the game.
You loved the surprise.
You loved it so much that you wish there was more?


Well, now, you can [b]keep it[/b]!

That's right! Other than minor fixes such as :
[list]
[*]typos
[*]Zan's toes becoming shorter when he blinks (nobody noticed that)
[/list]

You can now [spoiler] export your dragon in the 3D format GLTF! [/spoiler]
That's right ! [spoiler] export your dragon in the 3D format GLTF! [/spoiler]
It is available in the extras menu!

notes.title: Release Candidate is in testing!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
For the season, I'm gifting you with a tiny update!

I've worked hard on polishing, proofreading, and improving Six Legends.

So, the Release Candidate is now being played by beta testers!

I intend to provide a smooth, as glitchless experience as I can. 

Being a solo developer, I know there will be a few left.
But I don't want to leave ANYTHING that'll ruin the experience, or worse, lock players!


And now...
I'm taking a well deserved break.

Happy holidays!
